params.prompt: Premium Korean mobile-app performance ad key visual for Meta feed, 4:5 vertical. High-end glossy 3D render, studio lighting, soft shadows, crisp details. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no people, no hands, no money. IMPORTANT composition: the main object is placed in the LOWER HALF of the frame (from 45% to 88% height), the entire upper 45% is completely empty smooth background, and the bottom 12% is clean. Concept: me versus peers. Two 3D bar columns rise from a glossy smartphone lying on the floor: a tall glowing orange column with small simple 3D person figures on top representing peers, and a short translucent red column with a single highlighted person figure and a red question badge. Warm cream seamless background with soft orange glow, slightly low camera angle.
